story.title: Corona Hair
paragraphs_en: It was lock down due to Corona pandemic. Jay and Bella had to stay home all days for weeks . It was fun at the start - Wake up late ,run around in pyjamas , snack all day , read, paint and play all day long .
They liked to dress up and their Cat aka "Catson" joined in too . They pretended as astronauts and detectives and had heaps of fun.

Weeks passed. They noticed that their hair is growing wild and long and getting in to their eyes . They hadn't visited the hair dresser for months . Jay had an idea .Let's pretend as hair dressers and give ourselves a hair cut .He grabbed a scissor and chopped Bella's hair and his too.
The next thing they knew was that- they looked freaky. A yelp came out of Bella's mouth ."What did you do?"
Mum and dad ran in to check the yelping . Bella and Jay couldn't hide any where . Catson was looking up with wonder in his eyes .
" Oh my darlings... , You look absolutely weird but adorable . Is this the CORONA hairstyle?". They all couldn't stop laughing .
